title: 第40章 对门新开了家店
content_zh:
第40章 对门新开了家店-《重生80，分家后带妻女吃香喝辣》

上一章

存书签

下一章

林国强擦完桌子，又开始擦玻璃。

新安的玻璃窗上落了一层灰，他爬上凳子，里里外外擦了两遍。

擦完后退两步看了看，玻璃亮得能照见人影，满意地点了点头。

“三姐夫，你看我洗得干净不？”

赵志军把一摞碗端过来，码在灶台上。

林国强拿起一个碗看了看，碗里碗外都干干净净的，摸着没有半点油腻。

他点了点头：“不错，比刚来的时候强多了。”

赵志军嘿嘿笑了，把围巾往上拉了拉，遮住了半张脸，只露出一双笑眯眯的眼睛。

两个人忙活了一上午，把店里收拾得干干净净。

灶台擦得能照见人，锅碗瓢盆码得整整齐齐，桌子板凳摆得规规矩矩。

林国强又去后面仓库看了看面粉和调料。

面粉还剩大半袋，调料也够用，就是猪肉得明天早上现买。

“志军，明天早上你早点来，帮我去菜市场买肉。”

“行，买多少？”

“二十斤五花肉，十斤后腿肉，早点去，挑好的买。”

“知道了。”

赵志军点了点头，又问，“三姐夫，明天开业，你觉得生意能跟年前一样好不？”

“应该差不多。”

林国强把围裙挂好，“咱们的客人都是老顾客，十来天没吃了，肯定馋了。”

赵志军舔了舔嘴唇：“别说他们了，我都馋了。

十来天没吃你做的肉夹馍，想得慌。”

林国强笑了：“明天多做几个，让你吃个够。”

“说话算话？”

“说话算话。”

两个人锁了门，推着自行车往回走。

街上比早上热闹了些，有些铺子已经开始准备营业。

“三姐夫，”赵志军又忍不住问，“你说明天客人会多吗？”

“多。”林国强想都没想。

“你咋这么肯定？”

“因为……”林国强蹬上自行车，风把他的声音吹得有点散，但赵志军还是听清了。

“咱们的东西好吃，人实在，生意只会越来越好。”

赵志军追上去，跟他并排骑着，又问：“那你想过没有，万一有人也开个店，跟咱们抢生意咋办？”

林国强愣了一下，然后笑了：“你倒是想得远。”

“我就是随便问问。”

Lin Guoqiang finished wiping the table and started wiping the glass again.

There was a layer of dust on Xin'an's glass windows. He climbed on a stool and wiped it twice inside and out.

After wiping, I took two steps back and took a look. The glass was so bright that I could see people, and I nodded with satisfaction.

"Third brother-in-law, do you think I'm clean?"

Zhao Zhijun brought a stack of bowls over and placed them on the stove.

Lin Guoqiang picked up a bowl and looked at it. The inside and outside of the bowl were clean and not greasy at all.

He nodded: "Yes, it's much better than when I first came here."

Zhao Zhijun chuckled and pulled up his scarf, covering half of his face, only revealing a pair of smiling eyes.

The two of them worked all morning, tidying up the store.

The stove is polished so that people can see it, the pots and pans are arranged neatly, and the tables and benches are arranged in an orderly manner.

Lin Guoqiang went to the back warehouse to look at the flour and seasonings.

There is more than half a bag of flour left, and the seasonings are enough, but the pork will have to be bought tomorrow morning.

"Zhijun, come early tomorrow morning and help me buy meat at the vegetable market."

"Okay, how much do you want to buy?"

"Twenty pounds of pork belly and ten pounds of hind leg meat. Go early and pick out the ones you want to buy."

"Got it."

Zhao Zhijun nodded and asked, "Third brother-in-law, we will open tomorrow. Do you think the business can be as good as before?"

"It should be about the same."

Lin Guoqiang hung up his apron, "Our customers are all old customers. They haven't eaten for more than ten days, so they must be hungry."

Zhao Zhijun licked his lips: "Stop talking about them, I'm already greedy.

I haven’t eaten the Roujiamo you made for more than ten days, and I’m panicking."

Lin Guoqiang smiled: "Make a few more tomorrow so you can eat enough."

"Keep your word?"

"Keep your word."

The two men locked the door and pushed their bicycles back.

The street was busier than in the morning, and some shops were already getting ready for business.

"Third brother-in-law," Zhao Zhijun couldn't help but ask, "do you think there will be more guests tomorrow?"

"More." Lin Guoqiang didn't even think about it.

"How can you be so sure?"

"Because..." Lin Guoqiang pedaled on his bicycle. The wind blew his voice away, but Zhao Zhijun still heard it clearly.

"Our food is delicious and our people are honest, so business will only get better and better."

Zhao Zhijun caught up with him, rode side by side with him, and asked, "Have you ever thought about what if someone opens a shop and takes business from us?"

Lin Guoqiang was stunned for a moment, then smiled: "You think far ahead."

"I'm just asking."
